headline: House price index turns down again 2》Housing burden remains heavy; mortgage burden rate and price-to-income ratio both worsen - Liberty Finance
summary: Taiwan's housing affordability report shows the national mortgage burden rate at about 41.46% in Q1, up 0.71 percentage points from the previous quarter. The house price index turned down again.
why: Housing affordability and mortgage burdens shape household spending and credit risk for Taiwan's banks, which hold large mortgage books.
